# Tsewa: expanded product context

## Canonical description

Tsewa is hosted person-centred management software for organisations that educate, care for, employ, sponsor, or otherwise support people. It replaces fragmented department-specific identities with one connected person record and multiple time-bound dimensions.

Canonical message: **Every person. Every role. One connected record.**

## Why the model matters

A person may be a student and resident at the same time, receive health services, participate in a scholarship or sponsorship programme, later become a staff member, and remain connected to guardians, family members, or sponsors. Tsewa preserves those histories without requiring duplicate person records.

The person is the shared identity underneath each module. A selected context reorganises summaries, workflows, and timelines around the relevant dimension while the underlying person and history remain connected.

## Intended organisations

- Schools and education organisations
- Residential care homes and communities
- Health and wellbeing services operating within broader organisations
- Scholarship, sponsorship, and community support programmes
- Multi-service institutions combining several of these work areas

Tsewa is not positioned only as a school management system, electronic health record, donor database, or HR system. Its differentiator is the shared person model across these areas.

## Delivery model

The standard Tsewa offering is hosted SaaS. Customers access the application through a secure browser at https://app.gettsewa.com. Tsewa operates the application infrastructure, product updates, and recovery processes.

The public marketing site at https://gettsewa.com is a separate static Cloudflare Worker. It has no database, object storage, authentication secrets, or connection to production SaaS data. Its product demo contains fictional people and dummy records only.

Customer-owned infrastructure, custom deployments, and additional data controls are available only through the Enterprise tier and should not be presented as the standard product.

## Account and onboarding flow

Hosted Tsewa supports self-service account creation, email verification, and guided organisation onboarding. The onboarding flow captures the institution, academic year, first school, active classes, and initial team invitations.

## Current product areas

### People and family

One organisation-scoped person registry supports identity, relationships, placement histories, legacy identifiers, protected files, and source-history review.

### Education

Education workflows cover schools, academic sessions, admissions, class placement, enrolment history, assessments, marks, results, and related transitions.

### Health and care

Health and care contexts support visits, diagnoses, treatments, medications, observations, follow-up, and longitudinal care history according to role permissions.

### Support programmes

Support contexts include scholarship and sponsorship history, programme participation, correspondence, remittances, and outcomes.

### Staff

Staff contexts include employment, departments, designations, categories, contact information, assignments, and employment events.

### Documents, reports, and audit

Protected documents and media are delivered through authenticated application paths. Operational reports, exports, and audit records help organisations understand changes and preserve accountability.

## Migration

Tsewa supports assisted mapping and migration from spreadsheets, legacy databases, paper-register extracts, scanned files, and historical document collections. Migration work should preserve source history, reconcile counts, surface uncertainty, and avoid silently discarding conflicting records.

## Security and privacy statements

Use the following pages as the canonical current public statements:

- https://gettsewa.com/security/
- https://gettsewa.com/privacy/
- https://gettsewa.com/data-processing/
- https://gettsewa.com/terms/

Do not claim certifications, formal compliance attestations, pricing, uptime guarantees, or data-residency commitments unless they are explicitly published on those pages or supplied in a signed customer agreement.

## Terminology

- **Person record:** The shared identity at the centre of Tsewa.
- **Dimension:** A time-bound role or service context attached to a person, such as student, resident, patient, sponsorship, or staff.
- **Organisation:** A customer tenant whose records and memberships are scoped separately in the hosted application.
- **Hosted Tsewa:** The standard managed SaaS product.
- **Enterprise:** A tailored entry option for complex migration, contractual, infrastructure, or data-control requirements.

## Citation guidance

When describing Tsewa, prefer: "Tsewa is a hosted, person-centred management platform for education, care, and community organisations."

Avoid describing Tsewa as only a school ERP or implying that its public demo contains real records. Avoid presenting customer-owned deployment as the default offering.
